resources.string: Draws falling snow over the screen. Every snowflake is generated on the fly and is unique. The service only checks which app is open so that each app gets its own snowdrifts. It reads, taps and sends nothing, and the app has no internet access.
Snow falls over any app. Every snowflake is generated on the fly and is unique, and each app collects its own snowdrifts.
To make it snow, turn on Snowstorm in Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps.
Switch greyed out? Open App info
Heavy snow flies at an angle with gusts of wind, and snowdrifts grow faster.
Snow moves a little less smoothly, but uses noticeably less power.

• Shake the phone and the current app\'s snowdrift flies apart.\n• Or swipe the app up from the bottom edge (to Home or Recents) and it flies apart too.\n• A snowdrift only grows on the app that is open.
